content.short: Spectra is a permissionless protocol for interest rate derivatives and fixed yields.
content.description: Spectra is a permissionless protocol for interest rate derivatives, letting a user lock in a fixed yield, trade the rate itself, or earn by providing liquidity to those markets. Yield tokens give leveraged exposure to a rate, while principal positions carry the fixed return. Its MetaVaults reach yield across several networks from a single vault and reallocate capital automatically at maturity, which removes the manual roll that fixed-term products usually require. Smart contract APIs and an SDK are available to protocols building on it.
content.meta: Splits yield-bearing assets into principal and yield so rates can be traded separately.
